s.n: Emerald City pea and mint soup
s.note: Bright green pea and mint soup with a swirl of cream
s.how: Soften the onion and garlic in the butter for 6 minutes. Add the stock and bring to the boil, then the peas, and simmer 4 minutes. Add most of the mint leaves and blend until smooth and very green. Season. Serve with a swirl of cream and the rest of the mint.

s.note: Twisted puff pastry straws with cheddar, parmesan and paprika
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C and line two trays. Brush one pastry sheet with egg, scatter with the cheeses and paprika, and lay the second sheet on top. Press down. Cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each one. Bake 12 to 14 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool on the trays.

m.note: Buttermilk soaked drumsticks in paprika flour, fried crisp, with mash
m.how: Soak 8 chicken drumsticks in buttermilk overnight. Dredge in flour seasoned with smoked paprika and salt. Fry at 170C for 12 minutes until crisp. Serve with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and gravy made with chicken stock. No place like it.

w.note: Raspberry jelly in glasses. Tap your heels three times.
w.how: Make up a packet of raspberry jelly and pour into glasses with a few raspberries in each. Chill for 3 hours until set. Dust with edible glitter so it sparkles like ruby slippers, then top with a little whipped cream.

w.note: Twisted rings of choux, just fried, says Auntie Em
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe twisted rings onto squares of baking paper and fry at 180C until golden. Dip in a glaze of icing sugar, honey and a splash of milk.

w.note: Hard boiled sugar lollipops tinted in two colours
w.how: Boil 200g sugar, 80ml glucose syrup and 80ml water to 150C without stirring. Pour into two pans, tint each a different colour, then pour small rounds onto baking paper, swirling colours. Press a stick into each and leave to harden.

d.note: Lemon, pineapple and ginger. Follow the road.
d.how: Simmer 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and 1 tsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons and 400ml pineapple juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top with 400ml soda water. Finish each with a fresh pineapple wedge on the rim.
